title: Bike-sharing options to explore
intro: Soft CTAs for established Dutch mobility options when shared or subscription bikes fit your week. Private ownership deepens on the Cycling guide — confirm live plans on each site. This block is not a ranking of fleets, apps or shops.

items.reason: Maintained doorstep subscription bike with predictable monthly cost — strong when you want a reliable city bike without buying or hunting workshops after every flat.
Train travel for longer legs that often pair with OV-fiets last-mile unlocks — keep return windows visible before you leave the office.
Occasional shared cars when bikes and OV are not enough for a weekend errand — keep four wheels optional.
